Question 12(b) [4 marks]: How can monitoring and controlling be used to improve quality in the operations management of this business?
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
Magic Mowers Pty Ltd is an Australian manufacturing business that produces lawn mowers. These lawn mowers are then supplied to retail outlets.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
4 marks: Clearly relates cause and effect of monitoring and controlling used to improve quality in the operations management for this business
3 marks: Relates cause and effect of monitoring and controlling used to improve quality in the operations management for this business
2 marks: Sketches in general terms monitoring and controlling used to improve quality for this business OR relates cause and effect of monitoring or controlling used to improve quality for this business
1 marks: Sketches in general terms some aspects of monitoring or controlling used to improve quality for this business


ANSWERS COULD INCLUDE (the student does not need every point):
Monitoring: obtaining data about the performance level or quality of a process within the key business function. Controlling: once data is available, actual performance is compared to the plan for the metric and a decision is made as to whether corrective action is taken. Reference to stimulus: defect rate, quantity of lawn mowers, production capacity.

TEACHER MARKER COMMENTS:
Students did not properly define the concepts of monitoring and controlling, which hurt their ability to answer. The integration of the stimulus could have been better.
